# WPToolkit

> A zero-dependency PHP 8.1+ library for WordPress 6.4+ plugins and themes: deny-by-default REST/Ajax
> routes, entities and repositories over post types, custom tables and options, settings with secret
> handling, admin pages, views, assets, migrations and WP-CLI tools. Two plugins can bundle two
> versions of it on one site.

Namespace: `Codad5\WPToolkit` (or your own, if you scope the library). Package: `codad5/wptoolkit`.

## Rules for code that uses WPToolkit

1. The plugin's main file stays PHP 5.6 syntax and boots through `vendor/codad5/wptoolkit/bootstrap/guard.php`; real code goes in classes under `src/`. Without Composer, pass the guard `'namespaces' => array('MyPlugin\\' => __DIR__ . '/src')` to autoload your own classes (PSR-4).
2. One `Application::create(__FILE__, ['slug' => '…'])->providers([...])->boot()` per plugin. The slug prefixes every option, hook, handle and REST namespace — never change it after release.
3. Put wiring in a `ServiceProvider`: bind services in `register()` (no WordPress calls, no translation), use them in `boot()` — its parameters are injected. Never use a global registry.
4. Every route has an access rule: `->public()`, `->loggedIn()`, `->can('capability')` or `->authorize(fn (Request $r) => …)`. Public routes that write get `->rateLimit()`.
5. Declare route input with `->args(['name' => ['rules' => '…', 'type' => '…']])` and read it with `$request->input('name')`. Types: text, textarea, email, url, int, float, bool, key, slug, html, array_text, raw.
6. Return an array or a `Response`; throw `HttpError::notFound()` / `forbidden()` / `badRequest()` for errors. Never return exception messages.
7. For a post or its meta, check `edit_post`/`read_post` on that post and that its post type is yours.
8. Mark API keys, tokens and passwords `->sensitive()`. Read them with `$settings->get('name')`; `all()` leaves them out. Never pass them to `with()` or `forScript()`. Options are `{slug}_{name}`; pass `optionPrefix:` to `Settings` only to keep option names users already have saved.
9. Templates print through `$e` (`$e->html()`, `$e->attr()`, `$e->url()`); never `echo` a variable.
10. Every user-facing string uses `__()`/`_e()`/`esc_html__()` with the plugin's own text domain, inside `boot()` or later.
11. Declare assets with `AssetManager` (`->script()`, `->style()`); never call `wp_enqueue_*` yourself.
12. Shortcodes: `$shortcodes->add('name', $handler)` with `->public()`/`->loggedIn()`/`->can()`, `->attributes([...])` (same shape as route args), `->view()`, `->assets()`. Handlers return; never echo, and never build `[tag …]` strings from request data — call `$shortcodes->render()`.
13. A multiple-choice field (`select` + `->multiple()`) renders as checkboxes, or a chip picker above 6 options; `->display('checkboxes'|'tokens'|'native')` overrides. Do not hand-write a `<select multiple>`.
14. Change stored data with a `Migration` registered via `->migrations([...])`, never with branches on a "data version".

## Core API

- Boot: `Foundation\Application`, `Foundation\ServiceProvider`, `Foundation\Identity` (prefixed names), `bootstrap/guard.php`
- HTTP: `Http\Router` (`get/post/put/patch/delete`), `Http\Route`, `Http\Request`, `Http\Response`, `Http\HttpError`, `Http\Client\ApiClient`
- Data: `Data\Field\FieldFactory`, `Data\MetaBox`, `Data\Entity` + `#[PostType]` `#[Taxonomy]` `#[Table]` `#[OptionStorage]`, `Data\EntityRegistrar`, `Adapters\Repository\RepositoryFactory` (`->for(Entity::class)`), `Data\Query\Query`, `Data\Search\Search`, `Data\Migrations\Migration`
- Admin: `Admin\Settings\Settings` + `SettingsForm`, `Admin\Page` + `Pages`, `Admin\Notices`, `Admin\Column` + `Columns`
- Front end: `View\PhpTemplateRenderer` (via `Contracts\View\Renderer`), `Assets\AssetManager`, `Frontend\PublicPages`, `Frontend\Shortcodes`
- Services to inject: `Contracts\Log\Logger`, `Contracts\Cache\CacheStore`, `Contracts\Http\HttpClient`, `Contracts\Clock\Clock`
- CLI: `wp {slug} toolkit:info | routes:list | hooks:list | migrate | migrate:status | migrate:rollback | make:entity | make:controller | make:provider | make:field | make:migration | make:shortcode`
